description:
Cast Spark Double choosing to have it enter as a copy of Murderous Redcap, dealing 3 damage to any target.
Sacrifice the Spark Double to Viscera Seer, triggering persist.
The -1/-1 counter from persist and the +1/+1 counter from Spark Double cancel each other out and you deal 2 damage to any target.
Repeat until opponent are dead.
